findings.description: API endpoint accepts user input without validation or sanitization
findings.remediation: Validate that imageUrl is a valid URL and that theme and room are in the allowed lists (see utils/dropdownTypes.ts)

findings.description: HTTP client calls to Replicate have no timeout - can hang indefinitely
findings.remediation: Set reasonable timeout values (e.g., 5s connect, 15s read) on the fetch call to Replicate

findings.description: HTTP client retries immediately on failure without backoff - exacerbates service degradation
findings.remediation: Implement exponential backoff with jitter for retry attempts

findings.description: Retry loop continues indefinitely on persistent failure
findings.remediation: Set maximum retry attempts (e.g., 3) before giving up

findings.description: Identical API calls made repeatedly without caching results
findings.remediation: Implement caching layer (e.g., in-memory) for idempotent calls to the same prediction endpoint

findings.description: Debug statement left in production code
findings.remediation: Remove or replace with appropriate logging level
